title: ETL Developer
summary: ETL developers build the jobs that extract data from source systems, clean and reshape it, and load it into a data warehouse, using tools such as Informatica, SSIS or Talend. They sit in a data warehousing or data integration team and hand clean data to report and BI developers.
dailyDuties: Build and change mappings, packages or jobs in the ETL tool
Write SQL and stored procedures for transforms
Load fact and dimension tables, including slowly changing dimensions
Monitor scheduled loads and fix failures
Reconcile counts between source and target

skills.expectation: Build mappings and workflows in Informatica PowerCenter or IICS
Build SSIS packages that load SQL Server
Build Talend jobs that move and transform data
Design loads from source files and databases into a data warehouse
Write complex SQL and PL/SQL or T-SQL procedures
Load star schemas and handle slowly changing dimensions
Tune slow queries and long-running loads
Write Unix shell scripts to run and check jobs
Schedule and monitor loads in Control-M or Autosys
Check data quality and reconcile source and target counts
Work with Oracle as a source or target
Automate checks and small transforms in Python
Use Azure data services alongside the ETL tool
Keep ETL code and scripts in version control

groups.label: An ETL tool (Informatica, SSIS or Talend)

certifications.why: Useful where loads move to Snowflake
